description: S45 T3 (PM8): policy.changes answers the append-only authoring audit — one row per policy authoring write, naming the kernel-stamped actor (actorKind user for a socket peer, cli for the offline door), newest-first (id DESC — the audit's listing order is total, never a coin flip). The two NULLs are visible here and are NOT "": policyId is absent for the seed row (seed names many rules, reject names none) and proposalId is absent except on the row that decided a proposal (NULL is not 0 — a 0 would name a row that does not exist). summary is the fixed-template sentence the writer built from ids (SEC-033: never free text), printed untouched. unauditedPolicyIds is ALWAYS present ([] states this door has not looked — T4's reconciliation field); the empty-table statement is ABSENT because this table holds rows — that sentence belongs to the empty audit alone.
